name: dayze
description: Life Context for ChatGPT and Codex: your people, plans and memories in a private, correctable Dayze record via get_context_pack. Sign in with Dayze. No API key in the plugin.

interface.longDescription: Dayze gives connected AI tools Life Context: your people, plans and memories in a private, correctable record. Connect to hosted MCP and sign in with Dayze (OAuth). Available reads and writes depend on the profile and scopes you grant; get_context_pack is the starting point. The public notable-people catalog is separate.
defaultPrompt: Use Dayze to pull my context pack for this week.
Search Dayze notables for Albert Einstein and fetch the pack.
Log that I had laksa for lunch in Tiong Bahru.
